assets/audio/en/pairs/G44_1_girl.mp3.text: Mia dropped her ice cream. How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/en/pairs/G44_2_girl.mp3.text: Mia got a present. How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/en/pairs/G44_3_girl.mp3.text: A big dog barked. How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/en/pairs/G44_4_girl.mp3.text: A toy popped out of the box. How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/en/pairs/G44_5_girl.mp3.text: Elif knocked down Mia's tower. How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/en/pairs/G44_6_girl.mp3.text: It is evening and Mia is yawning. How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/en/pairs/G44_7_girl.mp3.text: Mia finished her drawing and Mom claps. How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/en/pairs/G44_8_girl.mp3.text: Mom is tickling Mia. How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/en/scenes/g60_ask_girl.mp3.text: Mia's teeth need a clean. Let's brush them!

assets/audio/en/scenes/g62_done_14_girl..text: Mia is hanging up the washing.

assets/audio/en/scenes/g62_done_15_girl..text: Mia put the clothes in the basket.

assets/audio/en/scenes/g69_3_girl.mp3.text: Mia is sick. Who can help?

assets/audio/en/scenes/g69_4_girl.mp3.text: Mia's tooth hurts. Who can help?

assets/audio/en/scenes/g69_5_girl.mp3.text: Mia is lost. Who can help?

assets/audio/en/scenes/g69_8_girl.mp3.text: Mia's hair is too long. Who can help?

assets/audio/en/scenes/g69_done_4_girl.m.text: The dentist looked at her tooth.

assets/audio/en/scenes/g69_done_5_girl.m.text: The police officer took Mia to her mom.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p1_girl.mp.text: Mia and her little sister Elif are playing with a toy car.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p2_girl.mp.text: Elif took the car out of Mia's hands.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p3_girl.mp.text: How do you think Mia feels now?

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p3_happy_g.text: Take a look at Mia's face. Mia is angry.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p3_sad_gir.text: Take a look at Mia's face. Mia is angry.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p4_girl.mp.text: Mia is really angry. She has a toy in her hand.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p5_tell_gi.text: Yes, Mia goes to Mom and tells her she is angry.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p6_girl.mp.text: Mia told Mom, "I'm really angry!" They took a deep breath together.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/praise_gir.text: Well done! You were a great help to Mia.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p1_girl.m.text: Today Mia is going to the doctor. Mom is with her.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p2_girl.m.text: They sit down in the waiting room. Mia feels a little scared.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p3_girl.m.text: What can Mia do when she feels scared?

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p3_hug_gi.text: Yes, Mia gives Mom a hug.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p3_tantru.text: Mia lay on the floor and screamed. Everyone looked at her, and she felt even more scared.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p4_girl.m.text: The doctor came in. She smiled and said, "Hello, Mia!"

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p5_girl.m.text: The doctor wants to listen to her heart. What should Mia do?

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p5_push_g.text: Mia pushed the doctor away. The doctor couldn't listen to her heart.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p5_still_.text: Yes, Mia sits still. The doctor listens to her heart.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p6_girl.m.text: The checkup is over! How does Mia feel now?

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p6_happy_.text: Yes, Mia is very happy now.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p6_scared.text: Look, Mia is smiling. She isn't scared anymore.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p7_girl.m.text: The doctor gave Mia a star sticker. You were so brave, Mia!

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/praise_gi.text: Well done! You were a great help to Mia.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p2_girl.mp.text: Mia went to the bathroom and picked up her toothbrush.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p4_girl.mp.text: Mia brushes her teeth nice and slow. Up and down.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p6_girl.mp.text: Her teeth are sparkling clean! How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p6_sad_gir.text: Look, Mia is smiling. Mia is very happy.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p7_girl.mp.text: Mia climbed into bed. Good night, Mia!

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/praise_gir.text: Well done! You were a great help to Mia.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p1_girl.mp3.text: Mia is at the park. She loves the slide.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p3_girl.mp3.text: Mia wants to slide too. What should she do?

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p3_line_gir.text: Yes, Mia waits for her turn behind Elif.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p4_girl.mp3.text: Mia waits for her turn. One, two, three...

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p5_girl.mp3.text: Elif went down the slide. Now it's Mia's turn!

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p6_angry_gi.text: Look, Mia is laughing. Mia is very happy.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p6_girl.mp3.text: Mia went down the slide! How does Mia feel?

assets/audio/tr/pairs/G44_1_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe'nin dondurması yere düştü. Ayşe ne hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/pairs/G44_2_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe bir hediye aldı. Ayşe ne hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/pairs/G44_3_girl.mp3.text: Büyük bir köpek havladı. Ayşe ne hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/pairs/G44_4_girl.mp3.text: Kutudan birden bir oyuncak fırladı. Ayşe ne hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/pairs/G44_5_girl.mp3.text: Elif, Ayşe'nin kulesini yıktı. Ayşe ne hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/pairs/G44_6_girl.mp3.text: Akşam oldu, Ayşe esniyor. Ayşe ne hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/pairs/G44_7_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe resmini bitirdi, annesi alkışlıyor. Ayşe ne hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/pairs/G44_8_girl.mp3.text: Annesi Ayşe'yi gıdıklıyor. Ayşe ne hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/scenes/g69_3_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe hasta oldu. Kim yardım eder?

assets/audio/tr/scenes/g69_4_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe'nin dişi ağrıyor. Kim yardım eder?

assets/audio/tr/scenes/g69_5_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe yolunu kaybetti. Kim yardım eder?

assets/audio/tr/scenes/g69_8_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe'nin saçı çok uzadı. Kim yardım eder?

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p1_girl.mp.text: Ayşe ile kardeşi Elif arabayla oynuyorlar.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p3_happy_g.text: Ayşe'nin yüzüne bir bak. Ayşe kızdı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p3_sad_gir.text: Ayşe'nin yüzüne bir bak. Ayşe kızdı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p4_girl.mp.text: Ayşe çok kızdı. Elinde de bir oyuncak var.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p5_tell_gi.text: Evet, Ayşe annesine gidip kızdığını söylüyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p6_girl.mp.text: Ayşe annesine "Çok kızgınım!" dedi. Birlikte derin bir nefes aldılar.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/praise_gir.text: Aferin sana! Ayşe'ye çok güzel yardım ettin.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p1_girl.m.text: Bugün Ayşe doktora gidiyor. Annesi de yanında.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p2_girl.m.text: Bekleme odasına oturdular. Ayşe biraz korkuyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p3_tantru.text: Ayşe yere yatıp bağırdı. Herkes ona baktı, Ayşe daha çok korktu.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p5_girl.m.text: Doktor kalbini dinleyecek. Ayşe ne yapmalı?

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p5_push_g.text: Ayşe doktoru itti. Doktor Ayşe'nin kalbini dinleyemedi.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p5_still_.text: Evet, Ayşe sakince oturuyor. Doktor kalbini dinliyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p6_girl.m.text: Muayene bitti! Ayşe şimdi nasıl hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p7_girl.m.text: Doktor Ayşe'ye bir yıldız verdi. Çok cesurdun Ayşe!

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/praise_gi.text: Aferin sana! Ayşe'ye çok güzel yardım ettin.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p2_girl.mp.text: Ayşe banyoya gitti, diş fırçasını aldı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p4_girl.mp.text: Ayşe dişlerini yavaş yavaş fırçalıyor. Aşağı, yukarı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p6_girl.mp.text: Dişleri pırıl pırıl oldu! Ayşe nasıl hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p6_sad_gir.text: Bak, Ayşe gülümsüyor. Ayşe çok mutlu.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p7_girl.mp.text: Ayşe yatağına girdi. İyi geceler Ayşe!

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/praise_gir.text: Aferin sana! Ayşe'ye çok güzel yardım ettin.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p1_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe parka geldi. Kaydırağı çok seviyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p3_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe de kaymak istiyor. Ne yapmalı?

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p3_line_gir.text: Evet, Ayşe, Elif'in arkasında sırasını bekliyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p4_girl.mp3.text: Ayşe sırasını bekliyor. Bir, iki, üç...

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p6_angry_gi.text: Bak, Ayşe gülüyor. Ayşe çok mutlu.
